This definitely feels like the first time it has ever been this bad.\n\nDoctor: Before this work reorganization, had you ever had a similar pattern of constant worry and physical tension for months at a time, or is this the first time you've experienced anything like this?\n\nPatient: No, I've never experienced anything like this before the reorganization.
